item.title: 2026 BAIC B40 Pro Trailmaster Review | A Real Off-roader?
item.description: The BAIC B40 Pro Trailmaster might not make sense at first, but the more you drive it and compare it to other dedicated off-roaders, it's got a fighting chance. Powered by a diesel engine, it goes back to basics. No hybrid, just pure diesel. However, open the door and you're greeted with a myriad of screens. Is this the best value Lifestyle SUV currently? Let's check it out on this episode of Behind the Wheel.
